claim: Try sample data in one click and see a completed reconciliation.
sandbox: fresh browser context; direct /demo; assert banner, completed result, reset, exit, and export

claim: Demo work uses a separate browser database and is discarded when the visitor starts for real.
sandbox: seed a marked real draft; enter and reset demo; exit; assert real draft unchanged and demo database deleted

claim: The reconciliation flow sends no CSV data, analytics, or tracking requests.
sandbox: record every request during the completed demo and exports; assert every request is same-origin and no account action exists

claim: Each CSV must have headers, no more than 50,000 rows, and a size no greater than 10 MB.
sandbox: leave /demo for real mode; submit fixtures over each limit and assert a specific rejection

claim: CSV, accountant PDF, print, and JSON exports are free and preserve row evidence.
sandbox: completed /demo; download and inspect CSV, PDF, and JSON; intercept the print call

claim: The completed demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: dedicated new browser context; load /demo; wait for service worker; set that context offline; reload and assert completed result

claim: A real current draft remains after refresh on the same device.
sandbox: start at /demo; enter real mode; import an order events CSV; reload and assert its filename remains

claim: US $19 once adds named history and reusable mappings; reconciliation and exports remain free.
sandbox: start at /demo; enter real mode; assert price, checkout contract, free scope; mock verification and assert activation

claim: Erase current draft removes the draft but keeps saved history.
sandbox: seed current draft and saved history; confirm erase; inspect IndexedDB stores

claim: The sample reconciles order events, the processor payout, and the bank deposit with visible source rows.
sandbox: completed /demo; assert totals, zero variance, source filenames, and row counts

claim: The app has no bank connection, commerce connection, or ledger-posting action.
sandbox: start at /demo; open Home; assert scope text and absence of connection or posting controls

claim: The build creates a static PWA in dist with every public route and service worker.
sandbox: open /demo, then assert built root, demo, legal, 404, and service-worker files exist and are nonempty
